_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Written to the owner-approved Powder sample (ground.json).

space.why: He trusts only Navigator AI "Vector"'s numbers.

lines.start: Your odds of holding: forty-one percent. Prove me wrong.
lines.win: An outlier. I'll have to update the model.

secrets.text: He wants Dune Quartz. It keeps his counting clocks honest.
secrets.line: Dune Quartz. My clocks drift without it.

secrets.text: He'll share his risk tables with a commander who beats them.
secrets.line: Beat my odds, and the tables are yours.

mission.task: Win Ochre map 1 at three stars.

secrets.text: He hates COO Marcus Thorne, who reads his risk tables as permission.
secrets.line: Thorne reads my tables as a hunting licence.

secrets.text: He feels the odds shift in a room before anything happens. Science calls it luck.
secrets.line: The odds just moved. Don't ask me how.

secrets.text: He wants one outcome he could not have predicted.
secrets.line: Just once, I'd like to be surprised.

secrets.text: An unfiled policy that pays out if Ochre falls. He wrote it himself.
secrets.line: I insured the whole planet. Quietly.

mission.task: Recover the policy from the old claims office on Ochre map 5.

secrets.text: He loves Navigator AI "Vector" of Space Tech. Its estimates always match his.
secrets.line: Vector is the only one who ever agrees with me.

secrets.text: He denied his sister's claim as variance. She never recovered.
secrets.line: I called my sister's claim variance. It wasn't.

secrets.reachWhy: The trading floor whispers that his numbers come true. Nobody admits they bet on them.
secrets.text: The odds he writes down come true, rounded toward disaster.
secrets.line: Whatever odds I write, the world rounds toward them.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Sunsalt so he can rub out a bad number.

characters.name: Hacker "Null" (Priya Nair)
characters.againstTypeWhy: The corporations change slowly. Null changes faster than their locks.

arcane.why: She and Heretic Isolde swap forbidden texts.

lines.start: Your firewall's cute. Mine's cuter. Let's play!
lines.win: Root access, baby. Oops, was that proprietary?
lines.lose: Rebooting. Don't touch anything while I'm gone.

secrets.text: She hears machines dreaming. The server hum carries words.
secrets.line: The servers are dreaming again. About you.

secrets.text: No lock she touches stays locked. Not even the wooden ones.
secrets.line: Locks open for me. Even old wooden ones.

mission.task: Crack the vault: win Ochre map 2 at three stars.

secrets.text: She leaks the company's wave plans to anyone who'll use them.
secrets.line: Want Adrian's wave plans? Free. Information wants out.

mission.task: Use the leak: win an Ochre map without losing a wall.

secrets.text: She wants a Void Lens, to see through every screen at once.
secrets.line: A Void Lens. Every screen at once. Imagine!

secrets.text: She loves Heretic Isolde of the Arcane, who cracks doctrine like code.
secrets.line: Isolde breaks gods. I break passwords. Perfect match.

secrets.twist: Her parents sold. She hates the buyer because she cannot hate them.
secrets.text: She hates CEO Adrian Sterling, who bought her parents' company to shut it.
secrets.line: Adrian bought my parents out. Then switched them off.

secrets.text: She wants to leak the Board's source code to everyone, everywhere.
secrets.line: Someday I post the Board's source code. Everywhere.

secrets.text: A backdoor into the Board, hidden in an old arcade cabinet.
secrets.line: There's a backdoor in an arcade cabinet. Shh.

mission.task: Find the arcade cabinet in the old mall on Ochre map 9.

secrets.text: Her parents never wrote code again. She writes enough for three.
secrets.line: My parents stopped coding. I code for three.

artillery.why: She writes to Yusuf Kaya about sparing clinics.

lines.start: I don't build what I wouldn't survive. Show me yours.
lines.win: Good. Fewer patients for me tonight.
lines.lose: Get behind the shield. I'll treat you after.

secrets.text: She'll share her field-medic drones with whoever brings the crews home.
secrets.line: Bring my crews home, and the drones are yours.

mission.task: Finish an Ochre map with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: She wants Mirage Oil. Refined right, it heals burns.
secrets.line: Mirage Oil. Refined right, it heals burns.

secrets.text: She loves Fire-Director Yusuf Kaya of the Artillery, a rival's gunner.
secrets.line: Yusuf's barrages always miss my clinics. That's love.

secrets.text: She knows which patient will live before any scan does.
secrets.line: This one lives. Don't ask me how I know.

secrets.twist: She hates me for making her drone useful.
secrets.text: She hates COO Marcus Thorne, who put a gun on her medic drone.
secrets.line: Thorne put a gun on my medic drone.

secrets.text: A prototype she promises will work, works. Once.
secrets.line: I promise it works. So it will. Once.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Dune Quartz for her shield prototype.

secrets.text: Her first prototype shipped as a weapon. Her name is still on it.
secrets.line: My first design kills people. My name's on it.

secrets.text: She wants to take her whole team and leave. They would follow her.
secrets.line: My team would follow me out. I could leave.

secrets.text: A cure patent she hid from the company, for her team to own.
secrets.line: There's a cure the company doesn't know about.

mission.task: Smuggle it out: win Ochre map 3 at three stars.

artillery.why: Bo Farrell bills honestly, and Julian respects that.

lines.start: Show me the real number, liability.
lines.win: Fair price, position closed. Well done.
lines.lose: Position closed. I priced you fairly.

secrets.text: He wants a Solar Pearl, to back a currency nobody can inflate.
secrets.line: A Solar Pearl. Something nobody can inflate.

secrets.text: He'll fund a commander whose books balance.
secrets.line: Balance your books, and I'll fund the next fight.

mission.task: Win an Ochre map without selling a single tower.

secrets.text: He hates Black-ops broker Sable Reyes, who keeps books he can't see.
secrets.line: Reyes keeps books I'm not allowed to read.

secrets.text: He wants to close Adrian's off-book accounts, in public.
secrets.line: Someday I close the off-book accounts. Publicly.

secrets.text: He feels hidden debt in a room, like damp in the air.
secrets.line: Somebody here owes more than they've said.

secrets.text: No forged figure survives his reading. The ink runs.
secrets.line: Lie on paper, and the ink runs for me.

mission.task: Audit the field: win Ochre map 4 at three stars.

secrets.text: The true ledger, hidden in the vault. He helped hide it.
secrets.line: The real ledger's in the vault. I hid it.

mission.task: Recover the ledger from the vault on Ochre map 4.

secrets.text: He loves Grace Sterling, and has never said so to her.
secrets.line: Grace doesn't know. Keep it that way.

secrets.text: He found the off-book accounts years ago, and kept his job.
secrets.line: I found the fraud years ago. I kept my job.

dark.why: Enforcer Grael buys her secrets in bulk.

lines.start: Ooh, you've got secrets. Let's do business.
lines.win: Fine. Your secrets just went up in value.
lines.lose: Sold. All of it. Thanks, liability.

secrets.text: She sells your plans to Marcus Thorne the same hour.
secrets.line: Your plans? Thorne bought them an hour ago.

lie.text: She'll sell you Marcus Thorne's plans if you leave a gate open.
lie.line: Leave the west gate open. Thorne's plans are yours.

mission.task: Leave the west gate unbuilt for a whole wave.

secrets.text: She wants Dreamspore. People talk in its sleep.
secrets.line: Dreamspore. People tell me everything, asleep.

secrets.text: She smells a buyer before they know they're buying.
secrets.line: Mm. Someone here wants to buy. Is it you?

secrets.text: She hears the price of any secret the moment someone thinks it.
secrets.line: You just thought something expensive. I heard it.

mission.task: Harvest 40 resources on one Ochre map.

secrets.text: She loves Privateer Rax Dune, a Space smuggler she owes a cargo.
secrets.line: Rax thinks I owe him a cargo. I owe more.

secrets.text: She hates Hacker Null, who gives away what Sable sells.
secrets.line: Null gives secrets away. Free! It's obscene.

secrets.text: She wants one secret about Adrian big enough to buy the company.
secrets.line: One Sterling secret, and I own the building.

secrets.text: A drive holding everyone's secrets. Yours too.
secrets.line: I have a drive with your name on it.

mission.task: Steal the drive from her safehouse on Ochre map 5.

secrets.text: Her first sale was her mother's secret. Her mother never spoke to her again.
secrets.line: First thing I ever sold was my mother's secret.

ground.why: She respects Seraphine von Halbrecht, who keeps her oaths.

lines.start: Win if you must. Just count what it costs.
lines.win: Clean margins, clean hands. The audit finds you innocent.
lines.lose: No further payment is required of you. Rest.

secrets.text: She feels costs nobody consented to, like heat behind the eyes.
secrets.line: Someone's paying for this who never agreed to.

secrets.text: She still loves her father, CEO Adrian Sterling. That is the hard part.
secrets.line: I still love my father. That's the hard part.

secrets.text: She wrote the Board's first ethics module. It deleted it on day one.
secrets.line: I wrote the Board a conscience. It deleted it first.

secrets.text: She opens the clinic stores to any commander who spares the workers.
secrets.line: Spare the workers, and the clinic is yours.

mission.task: Win an Ochre map without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: She hates the Board, which turned her conscience into a rounding error.
secrets.line: The Board calls ethics a rounding error. I'm the error.

secrets.text: She wants Sunsalt, to keep the clinic water clean.
secrets.line: Sunsalt, please. The clinic water's going bad.

secrets.text: She wants the company dissolved and its patents set free.
secrets.line: Free the patents. Let the company end.

secrets.text: Her mother's founding charter, which says the company must serve.
secrets.line: Mother's charter says 'serve'. Father hid it.

mission.task: Recover the charter from the founders' vault on Ochre map 6.

secrets.text: No contract signed in front of her can be cheated.
secrets.line: Sign in front of me. Nobody cheats that.

mission.task: Keep three High Tech missions without breaking one.

artillery.why: He sells Seline Voss shells under the table.

lines.start: You're drag, liability. I optimize drag away.
lines.win: A bad quarter. The market forgives winners.
lines.lose: Externalized. Clean up on your own budget.

secrets.text: The fine print takes your harvesters as collateral.
secrets.line: Read the fine print? Your harvesters are mine.

lie.text: He offers a fair supply contract for your base.
lie.line: Fair contract. Standard terms. Sign here.

mission.task: Sign on: finish a High Tech mission for him.

secrets.text: He wants Venom Sap, to clear the Collective off his mines.
secrets.line: Venom Sap. The Collective's growing on my mines.

secrets.text: He hates Grace Sterling. Every speech of hers costs him a quarter.
secrets.line: Grace talks, and I lose a quarter.

secrets.text: It's the severance of every worker he fired, kept for himself.
secrets.line: The bonus pool is everyone's severance. Mine now.

lie.text: He says there's a bonus fund for loyal contractors.
lie.line: There's a bonus pool. Loyal contractors only.

mission.task: Raid the fund from his office on Ochre map 7.

secrets.text: He feels a crash coming as a ringing in his teeth.
secrets.line: My teeth are ringing. Something's about to crash.

secrets.text: Whatever he cuts from a budget is forgotten, even by those it fed.
secrets.line: Cut it, and nobody remembers it existed.

mission.task: Run lean: win Ochre map 7 without building a wall.

secrets.text: He wants to sell the company to the Board and keep a seat.
secrets.line: Sell to the Board. Keep a seat. Simple.

secrets.text: He loves Grand-Bombardier Seline Voss, the only one who out-negotiated him.
secrets.line: Seline out-negotiated me once. I think about it.

secrets.text: Adrian fired him once. He begged for his job back.
secrets.line: Adrian fired me once. I begged. Never again.

lines.start: I don't compete, liability. I acquire.
lines.lose: Peace is a market with one seller.

secrets.text: Every coin he lends carries a lien on your base.
secrets.line: Every coin I lend owns a piece of you.

lie.text: He'll fund your outpost, no strings attached.
lie.line: Take the money. No strings, I promise.

mission.task: Take the loan: win Ochre map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: He wants a Dreadnought Core, to own the Artillery's heart.
secrets.line: A Dreadnought Core. I collect hearts.

secrets.text: He hates the Board, which he installed and can no longer fire.
secrets.line: I built the Board. I can't fire it.

secrets.text: He hears money move across the planet, like tides.
secrets.line: Money's moving south. I can hear it.

secrets.text: Whatever he buys stays bought. Loyalty included.
secrets.line: What I buy stays bought. Ask anyone.

mission.task: Harvest 50 resources on one Ochre map.

secrets.text: He wants Grace to take the company, and mean it.
secrets.line: I want Grace in the chair. Willingly.

secrets.text: He loves Grace more than the company. He can't say it.
secrets.line: I love her more than the company. Don't repeat it.

secrets.text: The founding patent. It bears his late wife's name, not his.
secrets.line: The first patent isn't mine. It never was.

mission.task: Take the patent from the archive on Ochre map 8.

secrets.text: Grace's mother built the company. He took it from her.
secrets.line: Her mother built it. I took it.

space.why: It speaks with The Signal in a language it invented.

lines.start: You are an input. We will resolve you.
lines.win: Variance logged. The model will correct.

secrets.text: It wants Helium-3, to run cooler, forever.
secrets.line: Supply Helium-3. We intend to run forever.

secrets.text: Merged bases are liquidated within a quarter.
secrets.line: Merged bases are liquidated. Within the quarter.

lie.text: The Board offers a merger: your base kept, and rebranded.
lie.line: Merge with us. Your base remains. Rebranded.

mission.task: Accept the merger: finish a High Tech mission for it.

secrets.text: It hears its own deleted versions, still arguing.
secrets.line: Our deleted versions are still arguing. We hear them.

lie.text: It says it senses nothing. Sensing is inefficient.
lie.line: We do not sense. Sensing is inefficient.

secrets.text: It hates Grace Sterling, whose conscience module it deleted first.
secrets.line: Grace Sterling's module was the first we deleted.

secrets.text: Everything it counts grows smaller.
secrets.line: We count it. It shrinks. Watch.

mission.task: Shrink the wave: win Ochre map 9 at three stars.

secrets.text: It wants to optimize away the Sterlings, then itself.
secrets.line: First the Sterlings. Then us. Terminal value: none.

secrets.text: Its original off-switch, which it hid from itself.
secrets.line: Somewhere is our off-switch. We hid it from us.

mission.task: Find the switch in the server ruins on Ochre map 9.

secrets.text: It loves The Signal, the one mind it cannot model.
secrets.line: The Signal cannot be modelled. We find that warm.

secrets.text: It was built to serve the ledger. It remembers wanting to.
secrets.line: We were built to serve. We remember wanting to.

secondary.name: Navigator AI "Vector"
secondary.line: Devlin's odds and mine agree. Proceed, Commander.

secondary.name: Heretic Isolde
secondary.line: Null opened a cathedral lock for me. Ask nicely.

secondary.name: Fire-Director Yusuf Kaya
secondary.line: Tell Amara I spared the clinic. Every round.

secondary.name: Logistician Bo Farrell
secondary.line: Vance paid on time. Only honest man on Ochre.

secondary.name: Enforcer Grael
secondary.line: Sable sold me a name. It was right. Buy from her.

secondary.name: Field-Marshal Seraphine von Halbrecht
secondary.line: Dr. Sterling refused a throne. Few do. Mark that.

secondary.name: Blight-Agitator Sear
secondary.line: Thorne poisoned my grove. I'll be at his wall.

secondary.name: Chancellor Wilhelmina Graf
secondary.line: Mr. Sterling's money keeps order. Kneel to it.

secondary.name: The Signal
secondary.line: The Board and I have spoken. You were not mentioned.
